seo.title: What I Do — Cedar Mill Plumbing · Mike Hollister
seo.description: Residential plumbing across NW Portland and the Westside: drain cleaning and hydro jetting, water heater install and service, repipe and leak detection, and 24/7 emergency dispatch.

header.heading: What I Do
header.lead: Four core service areas — done well, by the same plumber every visit, with flat-rate pricing on common calls and free written estimates on bigger projects.

cta.heading: Not sure which service fits your job?
cta.body: Easiest way is to call or send a contact form with a few sentences about what's going on. I'll tell you straight whether it's a flat-rate service call, an estimate visit, or something I'd refer to a colleague who specializes.
